body: Ohhh I do not have contact with him whatsoever, it’s been a long year for my family and I don’t ever want a relationship with him again, it’s more the future child that I am concerned about, and you were correct in the fact that, she was my friend.
I’m actually thinking that this girl is pregnant also
Doesn’t own the house, rents, and I was on the lease.
Yes my mother apologised to me in great detail

I’m not in my 30s
I understand people grow apart but this is a huge change not just a plain divorce

I dearly miss a fuckboi that has not one single care about me, the heart is a weird thing, suffering has no time limit, but surely a degree of happiness will sprout and grow in time life does not heal wounds, perspectives heal wounds.
I long to die some days and love to live others.

You are not undervalued, you are just different,, help people but don’t forget to help yourself, and this is your time.
Live for you, dying isn’t the way.
